title: Red Canoe: bring Lulu's chick home
kaylee: Lulu can't sing: her chick has paddled off. You find it in the milky water, it rides home on the bow, and then a tap on Lulu and she sings, and the glacier sings it back.
questions: I went with the chick lost (a big hug at the end), not hide-and-seek. Keep it?
Three songs before the stamp: too many, or just right?

pictures.title: 1. Find the chick
pictures.caption: A tiny peep from the milky water, louder as you paddle near. There you are!

pictures.title: 2. It rides on the bow
pictures.caption: Facing Maple, squeaking now and then. Lulu dives twice looking for it

pictures.title: 3. Home to Lulu
pictures.caption: The third time she comes up, she sees it: hop, onto her back

pictures.title: 4. The try-out
pictures.caption: Tap Lulu and she sings; the glacier sparkles and sings it back. Three songs, then the stamp
